sanskrit_verse:
लेख्यदोषास्तु ये केचित् साक्षिणाम् चैव ये स्मृताः ।
वादकाले तु वक्तव्याः पश्चादुक्तान् न दूषयेत् ॥
transliteration: lekhya-doṣās tu ye kecit sākṣiṇām caiva ye smṛtāḥ | vāda-kāle tu vaktavyāḥ paścād uktān na dūṣayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: All defects in written documents and those remembered by witnesses shall be declared at the time of argument; anything declared later shall not invalidate what was previously stated.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in timely and transparent disclosure
Causation is anchored in sequential integrity of testimony
Capacity-based responsibility requires full presence during adjudication
Restoration logic demands prevention of post-hoc manipulation
Consciousness alignment occurs through upfront truthfulness
executable_legal_axioms: IF a party introduces evidence AFTER the designated argument phase, THEN that evidence SHALL NOT override prior declarations made under conscious witness
IF a document defect or witness recall issue is known BEFORE vāda-kāla, THEN it MUST be disclosed IN THAT MOMENT or forfeit validity
ALL testimonial data MUST align with the chronological sequence of conscious awareness to qualify as pramāṇa
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court proceedings, this axiom establishes that any omission or error known prior to judgment but undisclosed until after deliberation cannot be entertained as grounds for reversal. The threshold of responsibility lies in the capacity to speak truthfully when called upon.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa functions only where there is no concealment; anupūrvaśaḥ ensures causes manifest in their proper order. Delayed disclosures disrupt causal clarity and are thus invalid. No punitive consequence arises—only disqualification from influencing dharma-reestablishment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Require full pre-vāda disclosure training for all parties
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Acknowledge lapses openly before court
Integrity Reintegration: Facilitate corrective participation in future hearings
Capacity Restoration: Provide access to legal literacy tools
final_declaration: Thus speaks Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of Dharma, wherein truth disclosed in its rightful moment restores balance without recourse to punishment, and consciousness alone governs the unfolding of justice.
